title: BrandLogo
description: Chumlab brand logo components: LogoMark (icon), LogoWordmark (text), and LogoFull (icon + text).

oneOf.title: LogoMark
oneOf.description: Renders the Chumlab logo mark as an image element.

className.description: Additional CSS classes for the img element.

oneOf.title: LogoWordmark
oneOf.description: Renders the Chumlab brand name as styled text.

className.description: Additional CSS classes for the outer span.

oneOf.title: LogoFull
oneOf.description: Renders the full Chumlab logo — mark image alongside the wordmark text.

size.description: Size in pixels passed to the inner LogoMark.

className.description: Additional CSS classes for the outer wrapper span.

textClassName.description: Additional CSS classes passed to the inner LogoWordmark.
